purpose: Positive end-to-end learning control on the current fresh sequential2B path. Distinguish the ability to learn six actual original TRAIN units from their existing imperfect free-running behavior. Not a Base-quality experiment or a rescue of parallel residual training.
parent_model_class: JMicroModel via explicit current residual model factory
dataset: Exactly the six already-bound actually-consumed whole TRAIN units. No DEV/TEST, no new data, no new source sample draw. Retain original BOS/body/EOS and next-token shift.
conditioning_prefix: Same codec-stable24-token prefixes as the completed six-case inference diagnostic.
probe_initialization: Shadow clone of frozen sequential2B learned weights; fresh diagnostic AdamW/moments/counters/RNG seed42 and fixed six-unit cycle. All capacity-control weights are discarded for science/adoption; original checkpoint remains unchanged.

optimizer.schedule: fixed constant learning rate, no sweep

training_forward: Existing right_padded_hidden and original supervised-state CE-only head; original whole-unit gold including actual EOS. Partially masked final budget update permitted; never synthesize an EOS.
resume_gate: Before capacity control, own CUDA continuous4 vs2+save+2 with fixed six-unit cycle/fresh AdamW; compare model/Adam/RNG/cycle/counters/history. Record verification learning separately, discard those gate weights, restore the original parent for the capacity control. Budget includes gate/training/decoding/save.
capacity_completion_condition: Actual exited process within300seconds; complete committed-update learning/accounting and saved state. Pass only if finite training and all six complete original targets are teacher-argmax-correct, and cached BF16/math greedy continuation from each fixed prefix exactly reproduces its original suffix plus real EOS. No quality-score replacement, no early guessed EOS, no selection of easier units.
capacity_early_stop: Evaluate complete six-target teacher accuracy every25 completed updates. Only if100%, measure all six original cached continuations; stop early only if all six exactly match including actual EOS. Otherwise continue until original-teacher3M or GPU300seconds, preserve a negative result without parameter or cap rescue.
decode_cap: For this memorization control only, fixed each original suffix token count+8, context<1024; larger than64 for long articles because exact original EOS must be reachable. The completed6-inference/DEV80 decoder remains unchanged. This long-cap control is never used to claim Base-quality gains.
persistence: Record real PID/boot/start, original parent/source binding, cumulative GPU ledger, original teacher/body byte/source/EOS counters, optimizer/RNG/fixed-cycle position at completed updates, raw cases and logs. Inspect prior GPU processes before launch. Restore original10B WebUI at end.
interpretation: A pass proves this fixed path can learn these six examples, not generalization or a solution for Base. A bounded failure is not proof that10M is incapable; inspect actual training/evaluation behavior, do not automatically extend or sweep. Earlier capacity and trainfit evidence used other checkpoints/data/trainers, and is retained.
